services.name: Bus Tours
services.desc: In addition to your DOE Public Facilities Bus Tour, join us for a tour of the Oak Ridge Associated Universities (ORAU) Museum of Radiation and Radioactivity! Tours offered on Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays from 1:30pm-2:15pm. The Oak Ridge Associated Universities (ORAU) Museum of Radiation and Radioactivity chronicles the scientific and commercial history of radioactivity and radiation. It has been deemed the official repository for historical radiological instruments by the Health Physics Society, and the Society has been generous in its financial support for the purchase of items. services.desc: The American Museum of Science and Energy (AMSE) is the perfect place to energize your meetings and events! The museum has a range of meeting spaces and audiovisual capabilities ideal for any of your needs. AMSE’s facility is separated into four parts. First, at our entry, is our Discovery Shop where guests can peruse a host of fascinating STEM and history related items for sale. Second, our permanent exhibit space covers over 7,000 sq. ft. featuring AMSE’s five area of exploration: The Manhattan Project, National Security, Big Science, Energy Leadership, and Environmental Restoration.
